column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE SRI LANKA ELECTRICITY

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

column2: This Act may be cited as the Sri Lanka Electricity
Section 8 of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of

column1: 2009 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is

column2: 8. Any person may participate in a bidding
